AstralEngine: architecture and runtime flow

Long image

A

Answer

AstralEngine runs its engine logic as browser JavaScript and renders through WebGPU. Node.js serves the project. The game and editor entries share one browser runtime: BrowserApplication wires startup dependencies, while BrowserRuntime owns lifecycle and frame callbacks. JSON scenes become scene-owned ECS data and produce render items each frame.1234

  1. src/main.js starts the game runtime. src/editor/main.js starts the editor runtime and mounts its tools.56
  2. BrowserApplication creates the platform and renderer, then starts BrowserRuntime.34
  3. Scene documents, asset manifests, input maps, and built-in component records stay at version 1.78910

Node.js serves the game and editor pages and the project data. Both entries converge at BrowserApplication, which wires the shared runtime, platform, and WebGPU renderer. This map covers the major codebase modules; the runtime map below expands scene and frame coordination.211134

3

How does startup data reach the GPU?

The browser loads index.html or editor.html from the local Node server, then runs the selected entry module.1112 The entry initializes WebGPU, loads the V1 input map and asset manifest, and asks the scene loader to build the main scene.1213 The scene loader acquires assets in a scene scope; the asset manager fetches GLB and texture dependencies.1415

The engine runs fixed updates at 1/60 second, with at most five steps per frame. It then prepares the scene and calls the WebGPU renderer.161718

Which contracts stay at version 1?

Version 1 applies to the current persisted contracts and built-in component codecs. The serializer can migrate older per-type records, but the active built-in component registrations remain version 1.1910

RecordVersion 1 shapeSource
Project package1.0.0package metadata20
Scene documentastral-scene with version: 1scene file7
Asset manifestastral-assets with version: 1asset catalog21
Input mapversion: 1 named actionsaction map9
Component recordtypeId, version, and data; built-in codecs use Version: 1codecs10, serializer19
Profiler captureversion: 1profiler22

V1 policy

Keep new project data and versioned contracts at version 1. The migration handler remains in place, but it does not require a version increase.

The editor edits the active scene through its authoring controller. Its export path serializes the live scene and downloads a JSON copy; it does not overwrite the project asset. The panel registry includes hierarchy, inspector, asset browser, console, profiler, and memory tracking.232425

The server also exposes a read-only asset-directory API. Its watcher sends asset-change events; the client stages replacement assets and commits them at a frame boundary.2627282930
